csv_project_name: CMAR for Global Learning Center 1st & 4th Floor Renovation
csv_agency: Board of Regents University System of Georgia
csv_scope_of_work: The Board of Regents of the University System of Georgia ( BOR ) as Owner , on behalf of Georgia Institute of Technology ( GT ), User is soliciting Statements of Qualifications from firms interested in providing construction management at-risk services for the construction of a project known as Project No. 2026-0005, Global Learning Center, 1st & 4th Floor Renovation for the College of Lifetime Learning at Georgia Institute of Technology, Atlanta, Georgia. The Project would involve the creation of faculty offices, a departmental workroom for unit -specific needs, and shared spaces such as huddle rooms, conference rooms and breakrooms intended to foster collaboration and enhance workplace functionality. Fixtures, furniture, and layouts would be updated to align with current campus standards. Planned building system upgrades would include modifications to the heating, ventilation and air condition system, including relocation and rerouting of existing systems; replacement of restroom plumbing fixtures; adjustments to lighting and telecommunications systems; and minor modifications to existing sprinkler systems.
csv_disciplines_requested: Design Build/Developer, Rehabilitation & Refurbishment, Construction/Project Management
